name: comp-325
blurb: Modal for new account creation with name, email, and password.
description: A shadcn Dialog collecting full name, email, and password; includes a Google authentication option and terms link.
use_when: Onboarding new users with a lightweight, non-navigating sign-up flow embedded in the page.
avoid_when: When password creation requires complex validation rules or multi-step verification — the form is intentionally minimal.
a11y: Form fields have unique IDs with associated labels; password input is type=password; required attributes set; full keyboard support.
